dedupe_keys.name: a decentralized multi robot dataset for early deadlock forecasting in smart factory navigation

description: Satyam Uttamkumar Dudhagara publishes one hundred simulated executions of two Carter robots navigating a shared factory. Zenodo supplies four ZIP archives, navigation parameters and documentation free under CC BY 4.0. Twenty-five plan combinations are repeated four times. Trajectory and event fields are logged at thirty hertz, while front and rear camera images are sampled once per second. These observations can benchmark early-deadlock forecasts and reliability measures in robotic material-handling simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this collection. The README distinguishes Isaac Sim trajectory coordinates from RViz2 goal coordinates and provides the conversion. Fixed plans and a single scene limit transfer to other factory layouts; stochastic repeats do not establish real-world collision probabilities. Isaac Sim, ROS 2 Humble and Nav2 are separate dependencies. No archive was downloaded, coordinate transformation applied or robot simulation executed.
